how: Kept by hand. Read from the Pickleball Association of Bermuda website (pabermuda.com: Where to play, WER Joell, Training, Events, Memberships) on 22 Nov 2026, with court counts from Go To Bermuda, Pickleheads and The Royal Gazette where the association gives none. Individual coaches are named but their private phone numbers and emails are left out on purpose: the page links to the association's own list instead. Days in sessions are 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday. After review_after the build log warns and the page says details may be out of date.

pab.name: Pickleball Association of Bermuda
pab.membership: Adults $50 a year, juniors (18 and under) free, lifetime $750. Memberships renew on 31 March. You need to be a member to enter sanctioned tournaments.
pab.chat: Mixers and open play are arranged in the TeamReach app. Install TeamReach and enter the group code PickleballBermuda.
pab.mixers: Open play and beginner or intermediate mixers at WER Joell Tennis Stadium cost $5 towards the court. Times are posted in the TeamReach group.
pab.league: The Commercial League ran on Tuesday and Thursday evenings from January to March 2026 at WER Joell. Teams register through the association.

venues.name: WER Joell Tennis Stadium
venues.fee: $12 an hour for adults, $10 for seniors over 60, $8 for juniors. Paddle hire $5.
venues.hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 9pm, Saturday and Sunday 9am to 5pm
venues.book: Phone, or the CourtReserve app (search for WER JOELL). Up to 3 days ahead. Cards only, no cash.
venues.note: The home of the association: mixers, the league and most tournaments are here.

venues.name: Press Court
venues.note: Indoor and out of the wind and rain, in the old Royal Gazette building. Courts have replays and automatic scoreboards.

venues.name: The Reefs Resort
venues.book: CourtReserve (Cross Court Tennis Academy), or WhatsApp.
venues.note: Home of Double C Pickleball and the weekend open mixers.

venues.name: Willowbank Resort
venues.note: Saturday afternoon beginner and intermediate clinic.

venues.name: Court House Squash and Wellness
venues.note: Indoor and air conditioned, on a squash court, so smaller than a regulation court.

venues.name: Pomander Gate Tennis and Pickleball Club
venues.fee: Group lessons $25 for members, $30 for others. Private lessons $75.
venues.book: Members book courts. Lessons are open to everyone.

venues.name: Coral Beach and Tennis Club
venues.book: Members and hotel guests. Weekly lessons and clinics.

venues.name: Princess Beach Club
venues.book: For Hamilton Princess guests and members.

events.name: National Championships, week one
events.note: Men's 4.0 and 4.5+, women's 3.5 and 4.0+, mixed doubles 4.0 and 4.5+.

events.name: National Championships, week two
events.note: Men's 3.0 and 3.5, women's 3.0, mixed doubles 3.0 and 3.5, and the Junior National Championships. Players must be association members.

coaches.name: Cayla Cross, Double C Pickleball
coaches.what: Open mixers and coaching at The Reefs.

coaches.name: Tim McKittrick
coaches.what: Skills training at Pomander Gate, all levels, members or not.

coaches.name: Bill Bucci, Bill's Drills
coaches.what: Drills on evenings and weekends. You book the court.

coaches.name: Ryon Outerbridge
coaches.what: Private and group intro sessions. PCI Level 1.
